exceptions.reason: CVE-2026-97058 (DoS via attacker-controlled format precision). Transitive dev/CI dependency of API Extractor through argparse@1; not a runtime dependency in the verified OxDeAI release artifacts. No patched sprintf-js release or upstream removal of argparse@1 identified as of 2026-10-19. No attacker-controlled format-string reachability has been demonstrated in OxDeAI use; this is not a formal proof of unreachability. Exit: remove this exception when sprintf-js ships a fix or the API Extractor dependency chain no longer includes vulnerable sprintf-js.
